caption: The drawing depicts a repeating pattern featuring stylized floral and leaf shapes scattered across a light beige background. The patterns consist of wavy lines and organic forms, with colors including red, blue, green, yellow, brown, and pink. Larger leaf and petal shapes dominate the left and right sides, colored in a gradient or segmented fashion with the same color palette, while smaller, similarly colored floral motifs are interspersed within the central area. The top, left, and right edges of the composition are bordered by a red zigzag and lined motif, while the rest of the background remains plain. The objects have soft, rounded, and undulating edges, and the curved lines create a sense of rhythmic movement through the composition.
title: Bedspread
